about: A few words on rankings that surprise, shown by a mark on the item's row (see _build/notes.py). items: the item ids the note is for. specs: the specs it shows for, as CLASS N (left out: every spec). slot: the slot it shows in (left out: any). simulated: true when it speaks of the simulation, and shows only in a list ranked by it. en, fr: the text in each language. Of the notes of an item, the first that fits a row is shown. Every fact is checked first; what an effect is worth is the item measured with and without it on WoWSims Forever 21377c070b (20,000 iterations).
